run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-16T13:58:06Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is a self-monitoring rule of the Prometheus in namespace prometheus. The rule is loaded from the mounted rule file prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-ac4fa589-688e-4d06-9c48-89982b78688c.yaml in ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 and fires on max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1 with for: 10m, severity warning (evidence 3313d52a-d242-45cb-ada3-6d2e577df696-t0:ace2a161-2358-44e2-a412-8a3c874b3cf5). That expression can only be < 1 when Prometheus has discovered zero Alertmanager endpoints. In namespace prometheus there is no Alertmanager at all: the Services are only prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, prometheus-kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter; the Endpoints list the same five with no 9093/alertmanager endpoint; the only StatefulSet is prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (1/1 ready); the 8 pods contain no Alertmanager pod; and the only two ConfigMaps are kube-root-ca.crt and the rulefiles ConfigMap, whose 33 keys include no alertmanager.rules file. The alertmanager CRDs (alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com v1, alertmanagerconfigs.monitoring.coreos.com v1alpha1) are installed, so the component type exists but no Alertmanager instance/workload was found. The strongest supported explanation is therefore that Prometheus has no Alertmanager endpoint to connect to because the Alertmanager component is absent (or an Alertmanager CR with zero desired replicas), which is exactly the condition the rule detects. Prometheus itself is not broken: pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Running/Ready with restartCount 0 and its scrape/ingest path is active (sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total[5m])) = 133.59 spans/s at 14:40:00Z). The pod was recreated at 2026-11-16T13:57:34Z, but the StatefulSet is at generation 1 with unchanged current/update revision, and the rule's 10m for cannot elapse in the ~31s between that recreation and the alert start, so the recreation is not the trigger of this alert. The rule's input metric and the Prometheus/Alertmanager custom resources and generated config secret could not be read in this Run, so the final attribution between 'no Alertmanager CR' and 'Alertmanager CR with 0 replicas / empty alerting section' remains unverified.

claims.text: Prometheus's loaded rule file for this alert (key prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-ac4fa589-688e-4d06-9c48-89982b78688c.yaml in ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0) defines 'PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers' with expr max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1, for: 10m, labels severity: warning, summary 'Prometheus is not connected to any Alertmanagers.'

The rulefiles ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 contains 33 rule-file keys (including prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-..., prometheus-operator, kubernetes-*, node-*, otel-demo-* rules) and none of them is an alertmanager.rules / Alertmanager rule file.

No ConfigMap anywhere in the cluster contains the Alertmanager alert rule text AlertmanagerFailedReload or AlertmanagerMembersInconsistent, consistent with the Alertmanager rules group never having been rendered.

In namespace prometheus the Services are exactly prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator (443), prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (9090,8080), prometheus-kube-state-metrics (8080), prometheus-operated (9090) and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter (9100); there is no Alertmanager Service.

Endpoints in namespace prometheus are the same five objects (operator 100.96.4.60:10250; prometheus 100.96.5.74:9090,8080; kube-state-metrics 100.96.5.42:8080; prometheus-operated 100.96.5.74:9090; node-exporter 9100); there is no Alertmanager endpoint (no port 9093).

The only StatefulSet in namespace prometheus is prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus with spec.replicas 1, status.readyReplicas 1 and currentReplicas 1; no alertmanager-* StatefulSet exists in that namespace.

Namespace prometheus has 8 pods: prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh, prometheus-kube-state-metrics-7c5fb9d798-tqssx, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 and five prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter-* pods; none is an Alertmanager pod.

Namespace prometheus has only two ConfigMaps, kube-root-ca.crt (2026-11-15T14:43:48Z) and prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 (created 2026-11-16T13:51:12Z); no Alertmanager configuration ConfigMap exists there.

The Alertmanager CRD types are installed in the cluster (alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com v1 and alertmanagerconfigs.monitoring.coreos.com v1alpha1), so the absence of any Alertmanager Service/StatefulSet/pod is not a missing CRD.

Pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was created at 2026-11-16T13:57:34Z, became Ready at 2026-11-16T13:57:50Z, both containers (prometheus, config-reloader) started at 2026-11-16T13:57:35Z with restartCount 0 and lastState empty, i.e. the pod was recreated, not restarted in place.

StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus was created 2026-11-15T14:44:06Z, is at metadata.generation 1, and currentRevision equals updateRevision (prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-677d847d59), so no StatefulSet template change accounts for the pod being recreated on 2026-11-16T13:57:34Z.

The Prometheus container runs with --config.file=/etc/prometheus/config_out/prometheus.env.yaml and the config-reloader container renders that file from /etc/prometheus/config/prometheus.yaml.gz (volume 'config', i.e. operator-generated config); the alerting/alertmanager configuration therefore comes from that generated file, which was not readable in this Run.

Prometheus is ingesting data: sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total[5m])) evaluated at 2026-11-16T14:40:00Z is 133.5889 spans/s, and metric names for job=otel-collector (40 names, e.g. traces_span_metrics_calls_total, otelcol_process_cpu_seconds_total) and job=kube-state-metrics (4 recording-rule names) exist in the queried window.

92 Kubernetes events exist cluster-wide inside the retained event range 2026-11-16T14:05:26Z-2026-11-16T14:38:12Z, and none of them mentions alertmanager in its reason, message or involved object name.

Primary cause: Prometheus's alertmanager discovery resolves to zero targets because no Alertmanager component is deployed in namespace prometheus (no Service, no Endpoints, no StatefulSet, no pod, no alertmanager.rules rule file), so prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered evaluates below 1 and the loaded rule PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers fires after its 10m for.

Alternative and not separable with the readable evidence: an Alertmanager custom resource exists in namespace prometheus but with zero desired replicas (or the prometheus-operator is not reconciling it), which would also leave zero endpoints for Prometheus to discover. The Alertmanager CR kind cannot be queried by the available tools, so this remains open.

Alternative: the Prometheus CR's spec.alerting.alertmanagers section is empty (Alertmanager disabled in the kube-prometheus-stack release), so the generated config contains no alertmanager target at all; the absence of any alertmanager.rules rule file in the generated rulefiles ConfigMap is consistent with the Alertmanager component never having been rendered, but the Prometheus CR and the generated config secret could not be read to confirm it.

The Prometheus process is not itself failing: pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Ready with restartCount 0 and Prometheus keeps ingesting spans (133.59 spans/s at 14:40:00Z), so the alert is not explained by a crashed or unscraping Prometheus.

Rejected: that the recreation of pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 at 2026-11-16T13:57:34Z caused this alert. The loaded rule requires 10m of continuous condition, the pod was Ready only at 13:57:50Z, the StatefulSet is unchanged (generation 1, identical current/update revision) and Prometheus is ingesting normally, so a fresh alert state could not have satisfied for: 10m in that interval.

Rejected: that Prometheus-side scrape failure or an overloaded Prometheus produced the alarm condition. Prometheus successfully scrapes otel-collector and kube-state-metrics series in the incident window and the alert condition concerns alertmanager discovery only, not scrape health.

Deploy the Alertmanager component in namespace prometheus (re-enable alertmanager in the kube-prometheus-stack release or create the Alertmanager custom resource so that a Service/Endpoints/StatefulSet/pod for it exists), then confirm prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"} is >= 1 and that PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers resolves.

With the required permissions, read the Prometheus custom resource prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus spec.alerting.alertmanagers and the generated config secret referenced by the 'config' volume to determine whether the alerting section is empty or points at a Service name that does not exist (for example an alertmanager-* Service in namespace prometheus).

gaps: The rule's input metric prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered is not exposed by the registered Prometheus data source: get_series for that exact name and get_metric_names for {__name__=~"prometheus_.*"} returned no series/names, so the metric value and its label set could not be read. Missing series is unknown here, not a zero value.

The Prometheus custom resource (monitoring.coreos.com/v1) and its generated config secret cannot be read with the available tools (custom-resource kinds are not queryable, and secrets are not readable), so whether spec.alerting.alertmanagers is empty or references a non-existent alertmanager Service is unverified.

The Alertmanager custom resource kind is not queryable, so whether an Alertmanager object exists in namespace prometheus with zero desired replicas cannot be determined; only its downstream objects (StatefulSet/Service/Endpoints/pods) were observed to be absent.

Cluster-wide negative checks that returned no_data cannot be cited as facts: the cluster-wide pod name filter for 'alertmanager' (66 pods), the cluster-wide Service filter for 'alertmanager' (52 services), the cluster-wide ConfigMap filter, the cluster-wide StatefulSet filter and the NetworkPolicy listing all returned no matching objects but with status no_data.

Pod logs were empty for the queried window: fetch_pod_logs on prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 and on prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh returned 0 lines (bytes_read 0) for current and previous container instances, so Prometheus config-load and alertmanager-discovery messages, and operator reconciliation messages, could not be examined.

Kubernetes events are only retained from 2026-11-16T14:05:26Z onward in this cluster and namespace prometheus returned no events at all, so a possible removal of an Alertmanager workload around 2026-11-16T13:48-13:58Z cannot be confirmed; the change_history integration is not available in this Run.

The alert payload reports an alert start of 2026-11-16T13:58:06Z, which is only ~32s after the new Prometheus pod was created although the loaded rule has for: 10m; the alert state of the previous Prometheus instance is unavailable, so whether the condition had already been firing before 13:57:34Z is unknown.

It is unexplained how this alert reached an Alertmanager at all while no Alertmanager workload exists anywhere in the queried cluster; the delivery path may involve an Alertmanager outside the cluster, which could not be verified.
Whether the alert has any downstream or customer impact beyond the Prometheus alerting path being unable to deliver notifications was not verified.
next_steps: Confirm from the kube-prometheus-stack release values/history whether the Alertmanager component (alertmanager.enabled) or the Alertmanager custom resource was removed, and when.
Read the Prometheus custom resource prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus spec.alerting.alertmanagers and the generated config secret to confirm the empty or dangling Alertmanager target.

Once an Alertmanager is deployed or reconfigured, verify prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"} >= 1 and that the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers alert clears, and confirm that alert notifications are actually delivered.
